# Launchpad Pro MK3 single-pad file fixtures

Collected 2026-11-10 through installed Components 1.72.5 native UI. User confirmed MK3 and connected it; Components shows ready. All edits and imports below were offline workspace operations. No Send action or hardware overwrite occurred.

- `components-blank.syx`: new blank mode, default name `*New Custom Mode`, 64 disabled pads.
- `components-cc.syx`: CC widget at top-left (wire81), CC0/ch1, momentary, on127/off0, red5.
- `components-cc104-ch15.syx`: same widget changed to CC104/channel15 (two field changes).
- `components-cc104-ch15-toggle.syx`: previous fixture with only behavior changed to Toggle.
- `components-note-added.syx`: previous fixture plus note widget at pad1/2 (wire82), note60/channel1, momentary, red5.
- `components-program-added.syx`: previous fixture plus program widget at pad1/3 (wire83), program0/channel1, trigger, red5.
- `independent-mixed.syx`: independently generated by `node_modules/.bin/vite-node tools/launchpad/prepare.ts`; CC104/ch15/momentary/red5, note112/ch15/toggle/orange13, program31/ch16/trigger/orange9. Name `Elixir MK3 Check`.
- `components-reexport-mixed.syx`: genuine Components export after importing the independent file. Inspected each widget's fields in UI. Components names the imported mode from the filename (`independent-mixed`), replacing its embedded name. All remaining bytes are identical; automated comparison normalizes only that documented name change.

Files use `F0 00 20 29 02 0E 05`, version1, file destination127, NUL-terminated name, empty metadata `00 7F`, settings `00 00 15`, then 64 eight-byte pad records in top-to-bottom row order, and `F7`. No checksum was observed in this subset. Record fields: pad address, zero-based channel (127=global), type (0 off/1 note/2 CC/3 program), number, behavior (0 momentary/1 toggle/2 trigger), on value, off value, off color. Note/program on/off fields are zero in these fixtures. Active color is mode-wide (21). Fader/keyboard/grouped metadata and older binary versions are outside the implemented codec and rejected.

These fixtures establish file interoperability only, not upload, firmware identification, storage persistence, physical event behavior or external LED feedback. SHA-256 values are in `manifest.json`.
